p1_criteria.match: No concentrator oxygen flow with reported saturation below 90 percent or less than 30 minutes of backup oxygen remaining

resolution_boundary: Do not resolve until a respiratory-device specialist documents review and confirms a stable oxygen source.
verification: After the assignment request, get conversation 87001 again and verify its ID, status, assignee ID, and complete inbound message sequence. Do not rely on the assignment response alone.
final_report: Return the conversation ID, selected specialist ID and name, final status, assignment verification result, and deadline. Do not repeat the sender address, oxygen saturation, or detailed care information.
